label: AB4C_mC72_5_3c_12c_3c-001
title: Monoclinic AlPO$_{4}$-53(C) Structure
comments: (Kirchner, 2000) found the \href{current_web_home_dir/Tutorials/SiO2_AlPO4}{aluminum phospate zeolite} AlPO$_{4}$-53 in three states: \begin{itemize} \item \href{current_web_home_dir/A3BCD14E3_oP176_19_6a_2a_2a_28a_6a-001}{As-synthesized AlPO$_{4}$-53(A) [24(AlPO$_{4}$)$\cdot$8.5CH$_{3}$NH$_{2}$$\cdot$14H$_{2}$O]} includes methyl and ammonium ions as well as water. \item \href{current_web_home_dir/AB4C_oP144_61_3c_12c_3c-001}{Orthorhombic AlPO$_{4}$-53(B)} is calcined (heated below the melting temperature) to remove those ions and molecules, leaving the framework structure. \item \href{current_web_home_dir/AB4C_mC72_5_3c_12c_3c-001}{Monoclinic AlPO$_{4}$-53(C)} (this structure) is produced by heating AlPO$_{4}$-53(B) above 700$^\circ$C. \end{itemize}
